items.title: Make claim-admissibility pack smoke task annotation compliant
items.context: convergence_check reports one annotation error: packages/main/src/tasks/claim-admissibility-pack-framework-smoke.ts uses @type test, but validate-tasks allows only feature, bugfix, refactor, chore. Fix the annotation only and verify validate-tasks plus convergence annotation compliance.

happy.desc: node scripts/validate-tasks.js passes after the annotation type is changed to an allowed enum value.

edge.desc: lattice convergence_check --json no longer reports Code annotations compliant=false for this annotation error.

adversarial.desc: Manual diff inspection confirms the fix does not change claim-admissibility smoke runtime assertions or registry behavior; only the @type metadata line changes.

items.userSees: node scripts/validate-tasks.js prints PASSED: All task annotations are valid, and lattice convergence_check --json no longer reports the claim-admissibility pack smoke @type error.
